resolutions.researcher_notes: StartYear1=2028 supported. Both trade sources (JPT/SPE and Oil & Gas Journal, independent origins) report the July-2024 $25bn contract awards for MGS Phase 3 and state the network capacity increase of ~3.15 bscfd is to be delivered by 2028 (Q4 2028 completion). MEED corroborates 2028 for the compression bids. Original Aramco press release (aramco.com/.../aramcos-strategic-gas-expansion-progresses-with-25bn-contract-awards) is the primary but repeatedly ReadTimeout'd on the verifier, so cited two independent trade reports instead.

LengthKnown=150 km, segment 'EWPS-1-EWPS-3 "4"'. MEED (Package 4 scope) describes 'laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-1 to EWPS-3, covering 300km' — i.e. 300 km for the TWO parallel lines (pipelines 3 and 4). This GEM row captures only line '4' of that pair, so 150 km = half of the 300 km MEED figure. DMS Projects independently lists Package 4 as the 'EWPS-1 to EWPS-3 Pipeline'. VALUE-INTERPRETATION FLAG: sources give 300 km for both parallel lines combined; the 150 km is a per-single-line derivation, not a directly stated figure. Consistent but reviewer should confirm the two-lines-as-two-GEM-rows split (a companion 'EWPS-1-EWPS-3 "3"' row should also read 150 km).

StartCountryOrArea/EndCountryOrArea=Saudi Arabia. MGS-3 is entirely within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia; MEED explicitly places the EWPS-1 to EWPS-3 east-west line in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia (EWPS = East-West Pump Stations of Aramco's domestic Master Gas System), and JPT/SPE confirms the whole program is in Saudi Arabia. Both endpoints in-country, uncontested.

Owner1=Aramco 100%. The Master Gas System is Saudi Aramco's wholly-owned domestic gas transport network; MEED ('Saudi Aramco has selected contractors to execute EPC works on the third expansion phase of the Master Gas System') and OGJ (Aramco lets the contracts and owns/operates the network) both confirm sole Aramco ownership. Contractors named (L&T, Kalpataru, SICIM, etc.) are EPC executors, not owners.
